segment.source: <end>
Hey. ::wheeze:: Hey.<end>
::sniff::<end>
Me - Eustace. ::wheeze::<end>
::Tenses up his neck muscles, gurgles briefly, then swallows.::<end>
You-- ::sniff:: sure are... ::gurgle:: a big one.<end>
You... ::wheeze:: boy or girl? ::sniff.::<end>
Exit's... ::wheeze:: that way.<end>
Wesley's... ::wheeze:: downstairs. Straight... ::sniff:: then down the stairs. ::wheeze::<end>

::You see a dried up, wiry mutie with noticeably bulging eyes. He is quick to inspect you, but slow to respond and does so with reservations.::
What do... ::wheeze:: you want?<end>

::The last word of his question is accented by a scent most resembling that of fermented fish. He continues.::
Uh: Need. ::cough:: What do you... ::wheeze:: need?<end>
<end>
Show me what you got. ::Barter.::<end>
Hey... um... ::wheeze:: thanks for what you... ::sniff:: did for us. I got some... ::cough:: extra items I could... ::sniff:: sell you. I wasn't plannin' on... Wanna see... ::gurgle:: it?<end>
Sure. ::Barter.::<end>
I wanted to ask you something first.<end>
::Wheeze::<end>
Show me what you got. ::Barter.::<end>
Who are you?<end>
Eustace. ::wheeze:: You?<end>
$(context.player.Name). Nice to meet you.<end>
::He nods.:: Yeah. <end>
$(context.player.Name).<end>
What do you do around here?<end>

Stuff. ::wheeze:: I do a lot of stuff. ::He observes you, continuing soon after.:: Huntin'. ::He pauses.:: Makin' traps, bolts... ::Another pause.::
If you're lookin' for someone to trade with... ::wheeze:: then you're talkin' to the right... ::coughs:: mutie. ::He almost smiles.:: <end>
I got some... ::wheeze:: huntin' gear and leather... if you're interested.<end>
So, are there any outsiders you trade with?<end>
Uh,,,<end>
Ferryman?<end>

::His eyes pop out even further.::
Ferryman... yeah, yeah... ::sniff:: Only... ::wheeze:: him.<end>
<end>
::Wait.::<end>
I can't... ::sniff:: answer that. ::cough::<end>
Well?<end>
Spit it out.<end>
Yeah... ::wheeze:: but it ain't with the pirates or the Serpentines. Mutual dislike. ::wheeze:: There is only one outsider that comes here.<end>
The Ferryman?<end>
You got it. ::wheeze::<end>
Who is it?<end>
The Ferryman.<end>
What can you tell me about the Ferryman?<end>
He's an old gentleman... ::sniff:: sailin' the sea... ::wheeze:: and scavengin' for stuff. He trades with us some of it, yeah. He's kind to us. ::He nods, his eyes following with a delay.::<end>
Anything else you can tell me about him?<end>

Um... sure. ::He hesistates for a second, his eye darting across the room. Such rapid movement gives them an odd floaty appearance, as though they are two lubricated balls moving freely in their sockets.::<end>
He's alone... ::sniff:: out there, you know. All by himself. And he's... ::wheeze:: got lots of time to think about, uh, life, the world - existence.<end>
Tell me more.<end>

Well, uh... um... I can't grasp a lot of what... ::wheeze:: he says - and he doesn't talk often - but it's often concerned... with the decline of... ::cough:: everythin', really. Civilizations, values... ::wheeze:: people.<end>
He's damn right.<end>

It is his... ::cough:: ideas about why all those things... ::wheeze:: are like that that's confusin'. Open spaces above the ceilin', travelin' down, irrelevance of time. I... it's too much for poor Eustace. ::gurgles::<end>
The world has always been like this, it's just that people remember the good things in the past and compare it to the wholeness of the present.<end>
The world is perfect as it is.<end>
Nah. ::sniff:: He doesn't like bein' talked... ::wheeze:: about. Or to, dependin' on who's... ::cough:: doin' the talkin'.<end>
What kinds of things does the Ferryman bring for trade?<end>
To us... ::wheeze:: meat, mushrooms, hides... materials. But... ::sniff:: he also finds pretty and odd things.<end>
Example?<end>
One time he had... ::wheeze:: this rock thingy. One side... ::sniff:: was rock, the other was crystal. Small thingy. He wouldn't trade it, though... ::cough:: I just saw him look at it.<end>
He finds other things as well... ::cough:: like ancient jewelery, pretty pieces... ::sniff:: of statues and art.<end>
Do you know the Ferryman's sailing route?<end>
Uh... so-so. He has... a fairly... ::wheeze:: regular route.<end>
A guess is better than nothing.<end>
Startin' with our place... ::wheeze:: his next stop is usually The Pirate Bay, then he... ::gurgle:: sails north again.<end>
I think he mentioned the... ::sniff:: "northeastern waters" a couple of... ::wheeze:: times. Then he comes back here, and... ::cough:: again and again.<end>
I know... ::sniff:: nothin'.<end>
Even if I knew... ::wheeze:: the Ferryman wouldn't... ::cough:: appreciate it. Nah.<end>
What was the Ferryman's route, again?<end>
Any points of interests nearby?<end>
There are a few... ::wheeze:: places.<end>
Like?<end>
Like... the siphoner pools... ::wheeze:: the hopper island... Red Line, although that ain't quite so near.<end>
<end>
Tell me about the siphoner pools.<end>
Just west of here... ::cough:: in a small cave. The siphoners are spawnin' like... ::wheeze:: crazy there 'cause it's rich in fish... ::wheeze:: especially if you venture further in. ::wheeze:: <end>
We rarely go too deep... ::wheeze:: 'cause of greater siphoners. Tough critters.<end>
Hopper island. Tell me about it.<end>

It's north of here. ::wheeze:: Not much on the surface, but there's a... ::sniff:: creeper nest underneath. Pirates of old used to stash loot... ::wheeze:: there before the buggers moved in. The Jetters visit it... ::wheeze:: so there's gotta be somethin' still there.<end>
We don't go there... ::wheeze:: all that often any more... ::He scrathes a wrinkly patch on his head.:: Rarely after the incident...<end>
What incident?<end>

Well... ::wheeze:: once the buggers came we started huntin' hoppers... ::wheeze:: in groups. We always had a spotter... ::sniff:: to look out for anythin' comin' outta their nest. One time... Five Fingers was the spotter.<end>
He had five fingers on his hand, plus the thumb?<end>
No. He had five fingers in total. <end>
Used to be Six Fingers, but that... ::wheeze:: didn't work out. ::He almost smiles.::<end>
Anyways... ::wheeze:: <end>

Five Fingers fell asleep and... ::wheeze:: got devoured by the buggers. Another mutie, Rags, got snatched too, as... ::wheeze:: there was no spotter to warn him. ::cough:: All we found of him was an undeployed bear trap.<end>
It's become too dangerous, so we... ::sniff:: rarely go there now... ::wheeze:: And if we do... we bring lotsa guns.<end>
He had five fingers on each of his hands, plus the thumbs?<end>
He had five fingers in total?<end>
Five in total. <end>
And?<end>
The Red Line?<end>
::He points northeast.:: There, in the distance... ::wheeze:: there is a shore. Red 'cause of the red reeds growin' on it. That's... ::wheeze:: the Red Line.<end>
And what's behind the Red Line?<end>
Muties don't go there... ::cough:: but the Ferryman does. He told me about - what was it...- ::sniff:: the Fetid... ::wheeze:: Marsh.<end>
What do you know about the Fetid Marsh?<end>

If memory serves... ::sniff:: the Ferryman spoke... ::wheeze:: about a foul-smellin' mist permeatin' the area. The Marsh has... ::wheeze:: venomous buggers livin' in it. Sometimes... the water brings their carcasses... ::sniff:: all the way to here. Ugly buggers.<end>
But they make some kinda... ::wheeze:: glowin' honey. He, the Ferryman, trades it with us... ::wheeze:: It <end>
makes the body... ::wheeze:: feel good, yeah. ::sniff::<end>
But the honey... <end>
What about this island?<end>

Nothin' much here... ::wheeze:: Interestin'. This used to be a warehouse of some kind... ::wheeze:: Easy to tell. The only interestin' thing... ::wheeze:: is that the ground in front of the warehouse has been slowly sinkin' for years. It'll get completely submerged soon, I reckon. ::wheeze::<end>
What did you find in the warehouse when you arrived here?<end>

Well, I wasn't here with the first settlers... ::wheeze:: I arrived about sixty years ago... ::sniff:: so I didn't get to see the warehouse in its original condition. But from the stories... ::wheeze:: I've heard, there was all sorts of things in here, like... ::sniff:: various mechanical parts, electronic components... ::wheeze:: tools, materials.<end>

That's only on the top two levels... ::wheeze:: no one ever went deeper. Some of this... ::wheeze:: stuff was in bad condition 'cause of moisture... corrosion, but what was good was either used in creatin' the refuge or was... traded.<end>
Why didn't anyone go there?<end>
Well... ::wheeze:: actually they did. And they didn't come back. ::wheeze:: There you go.<end>
There's somethin' down there for sure. ::wheeze:: If you stand by the crane shaft... ::sniff:: you can hear things movin' down there.<end>
Crane shaft?<end>
Yeah, just over there... ::He points northeast.:: That room in the corner.<end>
Some folks used... ::wheeze:: to sleep near it. ::He shivers, which causes his eyes to twitch independently in rhythm for a few seconds.::<end>
I... ::cough:: can't talk about that.<end>
What do you know about the expedition?<end>

The newcomers? They came here... ::wheeze:: about two weeks ago, armed... ::wheeze:: and ready. Set up... ::sniff:: camp on the island to the east, but no one... ::wheeze:: likes their new neighbors.<end>
They packed their... ::gurgle:: bags and left... ::wheeze:: so <end>
they ain't gonna bother no one anymore.<end>
Since... the Serpentines... ::wheeze:: wiped them out... ::sniff:: <end>
The Serpentines... ::wheeze:: are in a war with them now... and <end>
your mates <end>
have shown their... ::wheeze:: displeasure on numerous... ::sniff:: occasions.<end>
What's on the island?<end>
Ruins. ::wheeze:: There's a couple large buildings there. Everythin' else... ::cough:: is rubble.<end>
How come the pirates never set up camp over there?<end>
Some have tried... ::wheeze:: but the... ::sniff:: Serpentines drove them out.<end>
the pirates <end>
What do you know about the pirate territory?<end>
Uh... ain't you... ::sniff:: supposed to know more... ::wheeze:: about that than me?<end>
Yeah. ::cough::<end>

It's The Pirate Bay... ::wheeze:: Many generations of pirates have been... ::cough:: there, in the past. Before they built the walls... ::sniffs:: you could see a huge battleship... ::wheeze:: but no more.<end>
Now it's nothin' but... ::wheeze:: walls and jetters patrollin'. That's all you can... ::sniff:: see.<end>
Tell me about the native territory.<end>
The Serpentines... ::wheeze:: rule everythin' north of here. Unlike <end>
your mates... ::wheeze:: <end>

they ain't got fast movin'... ::wheeze:: jets to chase after you. But they... ::wheeze:: got huge ships made of bone... ::sniff:: and leather. And they got natural... ::wheeze:: predators guardin' their waters.<end>
The Ferryman... has been there. No one... ::wheeze:: else. No one else... ::cough:: and came back alive.<end>
the pirates <end>
Can you tell me anything about the local wildlife?<end>

Serpents... ::wheeze:: rule the sea.
Crabs rule... ::sniff:: the sands.
Siphoners rule the... ::cough:: pools.
Creepers - the dark caves... ::wheeze::<end>
<end>
You have hoppers here?<end>

Uh... yeah. ::He nods, wheezing.:: They've been brought here a long time ago... ::wheeze:: 'cause they're easy to keep. But they... ::sniff:: kept dyin' in captivity. ::wheeze:: It's us, I guess. So we let them inhabit the surroundin' lands... ::wheeze::<end>
They haven't spread far, though. ::wheeze:: Lotsa hungry critters 'round here.<end>
Forget I said anythin'. <end>
::Wheeze::<end>
Tell me about the crabs.<end>
Burrow under the... ::wheeze:: sand. Then they... ::sniff:: burst out to getcha. The big buggers do... ::wheeze:: the small ones can't hurt you.<end>
But the big ones... some can even zap ya. ::wheeze:: BzzZzz! And you're... ::cough:: dead.<end>
These serpents...<end>
Dangerous. They ain't got the taste for us... ::wheeze:: luckily, so they don't linger... ::sniff:: around this island.<end>
But they love... ::wheeze:: <end>
your friends on... ::cough:: jets. <end>
Pirates... ::wheeze:: too. They're fast... and got a real nasty bite. ::wheeze:: All of 'em.<end>
the newcomers on... ::cough:: jets. <end>
Your mates too.<end>
What can you tell me about the local siphoners?<end>
There are lesser ones... ::wheeze:: and there are greater ones... Pretty much the same things other than size... ::wheeze:: The greater ones taste a bit better, though. <end>
Or so they... ::wheeze:: told me. I can't taste nothin'.<end>
Creepers?<end>
Giant spiders. ::wheeze:: Web-weavin' buggers. Their venom can blind... ::wheeze:: you.<end>
There's a nest nearby... ::wheeze:: They moved in to eat... ::wheeze:: our hoppers. Huge nest... ::wheeze:: underground.<end>
Let me ask you something else.<end>
I have no more questions.<end>
Wouldn't know... ::wheeze::<end>
This is the... ::sniff:: most borin' part of the Black Sea... ::wheeze:: for sure.<end>
About the surrounding areas...<end>
Questions? ::wheeze::<end>
That monolith at the entrance, what do you know about it?<end>
It's been there since we... ::wheeze:: came. Ain't got the faintest what it... ::sniff:: is or does. <end>
Heard plenty of stories... ::wheeze:: But I don't know. However... ::sniff:: the Serpentines... they fear it. ::wheeze:: Scares the... ::sniff:: crap outta them.<end>
How come?<end>

They avoid it like leprosy... ::sniff:: even cover their eyes as to not look at it. ::wheeze:: And if the currents bring their boats close... ::sniff:: they start frantically rowin'... ::wheeze:: back. You can just see it. Frantically, yeah. ::cough::<end>
It's just there... ::wheeze:: and you stop payin' attention to it after a while.<end>
I have to go now.<end>
<end>
<end>

::He tenses up his neck muscles, gurgles briefly, then swallows.::
What? ::wheeze:: ...Can I do for you? ::sniff::<end>

::He coughs so violently that his eyes seem like they're going to pop out; one of them even enters a cycle of intense twitching which lasts longer than any sane person would want.::
Yeah? ::wheeze::<end>

::He rubs his forehead.::
Hnnnn... one... second...
::It takes him about ten instead, after whose expiration he sighs in relief and looks at you.::
Where... ::wheeze:: were we?<end>
Hey... ::wheeze:: the headaches... ::wheeze:: have stopped. ::His eye twitches.::<end>

::He peels a strip of skin from his forearm and puts it in a yellowish nylon bag.::
What is-- ::wheeze:: What can I do for you?<end>
What do you... ::wheeze:: *need*?<end>
